name: Clear Clipboard History
description: Removes locally stored clipboard history entries to protect sensitive data like passwords or tokens from being pasted later. Note that this action does not delete the current copied content and third-party apps may retain their own copies.

description_i18n.en: Removes locally stored clipboard history entries to protect sensitive data like passwords or tokens from being pasted later. Note that this action does not delete the current copied content and third-party apps may retain their own copies.
description_i18n.de: Entfernt lokal gespeicherte Einträge aus dem Zwischenablageverlauf, um sensible Daten wie Passwörter oder Tokens vor späterem Einfügen zu schützen. Beachten Sie, dass dieser Vorgang den aktuell kopierten Inhalt nicht löscht und Drittanbieter-Apps ihre eigenen Kopien behalten können.
description_i18n.fr: Supprime les entrées d'historique du presse-papiers stockées localement pour protéger des données sensibles comme des mots de passe ou jetons contre un collage ultérieur. Notez que cette action ne supprime pas le contenu actuellement copié et que les applications tierces peuvent conserver leurs propres copies.

warnings.title: Clipboard history cleared immediately
warnings.message: All locally stored clipboard history entries are deleted instantly and cannot be recovered through this tool. Applications relying on copied content may lose access to it, while third-party managers or cloud sync services might retain their

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: This script invokes the Windows Clipboard API to clear stored history entries and overwrites the active content with an empty string
